transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm seeking help because my mood has been completely out of control lately. For about eight months, I've been feeling deeply depressed, sad, and empty inside. But over the last three months, I've also had times where I have extreme energy and get incredibly irritable over the smallest things.
During those times when your energy is extremely high, do you ever experience things that others don't seem to see or hear, or do you have any unusual beliefs that seem impossible to others?

Yes, during those high-energy periods, I definitely hear voices, see things that aren't there, and get convinced of things that others say are impossible. However, these experiences only happen during those three-month bursts when my mood is super high, and never when I'm feeling depressed or normal.
Do you ever experience those voices or unusual beliefs during periods when your mood is stable or when you are feeling depressed, or do they strictly only occur during your high-energy episodes?
No, they strictly only happen during those high-energy times. I never experience any of those voices or unusual beliefs when my mood is stable or when I'm feeling down.
